title: Abbaa Taayitaa Hin Danda’amne
intro: Biyyoota durii hunda keessatti, yeroo tokko abbaan taayitaa humna guddaa qabu tokko qabeenya guddaa fi jireenya namoota dhuunfaa lakkoofsa hin qabne ajaja ture. Mallattoo fi akeekkachiisni ifa ta’e jiraatus, bulchaan kun daandii mormii filate, kunis waldhabdee gadi fagoo yeroon itti dhaga’amutti geesseera.
clues: Aangoo fi aangoo dhumaa domeenii bal’aa irratti qaba jedheen himadhe.
Ergamaa gad of deebisu Gooftaan mootummoota hundaan erge tokkon morme.
Ummanni koo caasaa gurguddaa fi laga qaroomina keenya itti fufsiisu irratti dandeettii qabaachuu isaatiin beekama ture.
Ulee gara bofaatti jijjiiramuu fi harki ifaan ibsu dabalatee mallattoo dinqii hedduu argeera.
Ajajni waaqayyoo naaf kennus gareen namoota garboomfaman lafa koo gadhiisuu dide.
Uummata deemaa jiru ari’uun koo anaa fi waraana koo gara garaa galaana qoqqoodame tokkootti geesse.
arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا غَـٰفِلِينَ
verse: So We took retribution from them, and We drowned them in the sea because they denied Our signs and were heedless of them. (7:136)
